summary: Phase 3 Implementation Plan for Closed-Loop Out-of-Sample RSI in Desk OS v3: Full Truth Machine gate (dev, sealed val with Deflated Sharpe Ratio, one-shot holdout, bundle export), Meta-Bandit operator selection weighted by out-of-sample val survival, automatic Equal-Risk-Contribution (ERC) master portfolio construction, and a continuous background RSI iteration daemon alongside on-demand campaigns.
